The new line tells readers to "See CONTRIBUTING.", but this branch has no `CONTRIBUTING`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, or equivalent file, and the text is not a markdown link. Anyone following the README for contribution guidance will not find a target.

Add a real `CONTRIBUTING.md` (or point the sentence at an existing doc with a working relative link, e.g. `[CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md)`).

summary:
## Verdict

Docs touch-up has one real gap: README points at contribution docs that are not in the tree.

## Notes

- `README.md` now says "See CONTRIBUTING." There is no `CONTRIBUTING`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, or similar file on this branch, and the text is plain prose rather than a markdown link. Anyone following the new line hits a dead end.
- `poetry.lock` is in the PR (omitted from inline review as a lockfile). It moves `pyyaml` from `6.0.2` to `5.3.1` with no `pyproject.toml` or other manifest in the repo. Worth confirming that downgrade was intentional and not an accidental re-resolve; older PyYAML lines carried known load-safety CVEs depending on usage.

No repository instruction files (`AGENTS.md` / review extensions) were present to apply as extra rules.

**Recommendation:** request-changes
